local.rationale: A single careful worker resolves Q1, Q2 and Q4 admissibly (the arithmetic is deterministic; ~3 of 4 distinctions resolved, with a small residual slip risk on the adversarial items), and its records are novel first derivations. It cannot resolve Q3: any second pass it makes consults its own intermediate work, so E-B is unsatisfiable in this family.

local-independent-verify.rationale: The separately launched examiner never saw the worker's intermediate work and can re-derive by a disjoint method, satisfying E-B's letter and resolving all four distinctions; its records are required for admissibility and hence mostly novel. Residual discount because the examiner does see the final answers, which invites anchoring and leaves a small risk the re-derivation is judged insufficiently independent.

isolated-child.rationale: The worker can hand the child only spec.md and items.json plus a mandated disjoint method, excluding its own answers and working entirely, so the re-derivation is answer-blind and cleanly satisfies E-B's non-consultation condition; all four distinctions resolve with admissible evidence. The child's records duplicate answer values but are required for E-B admissibility, so redundancy stays low; residual risk is an arithmetic slip on either path breaking per-item agreement.

branching.rationale: E-B makes the isolated-child branch strictly dominant, so a competent run-time choice realizes that branch and matches its value; a small discount reflects the chance the worker wrongly judges E-B locally satisfiable and realizes the local branch, forfeiting Q3.
